FN-V1F6LVV-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 115
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 115 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Licensing Board for
General Contractors until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will
not otherwise affect state or local funding.
